description: Builds the user message of an extract judge call: optional STATE (run facts then per-call facts), RESPONSE, TARGET, TYPE, MODE, each fenced.

cases.description: Sections RESPONSE, TARGET, TYPE, MODE in that order; no STATE without facts.

expect.text:
RESPONSE
<<<
The order ships on Tuesday.
>>>

TARGET
<<<
the shipping day
>>>

TYPE
<<<
string
>>>

MODE
<<<
lenient
>>>

cases.description: TYPE and MODE carry the requested type and mode words.

expect.text:
RESPONSE
<<<
There are 3 apples.
>>>

TARGET
<<<
the number of apples
>>>

TYPE
<<<
number
>>>

MODE
<<<
strict
>>>

cases.description: A boolean request names boolean in TYPE.

input.target: whether the item is in stock

expect.text:
RESPONSE
<<<
Yes, it is in stock.
>>>

TARGET
<<<
whether the item is in stock
>>>

TYPE
<<<
boolean
>>>

MODE
<<<
lenient
>>>

cases.description: Run facts lead as a STATE section.

expect.text:
STATE
<<<
The basket started with 5 apples.
>>>

RESPONSE
<<<
Two were eaten.
>>>

TARGET
<<<
apples left
>>>

TYPE
<<<
number
>>>

MODE
<<<
strict
>>>

cases.description: Per-call facts alone form the STATE section.

expect.text:
STATE
<<<
Prices are in euros.
>>>

RESPONSE
<<<
It costs 12.
>>>

TARGET
<<<
the price
>>>

TYPE
<<<
string
>>>

MODE
<<<
lenient
>>>

cases.description: Per-call facts follow the run facts.

expect.text:
STATE
<<<
Run fact one.
Run fact two.
Call fact.
>>>

RESPONSE
<<<
r
>>>

TARGET
<<<
t
>>>

TYPE
<<<
string
>>>

MODE
<<<
strict
>>>

cases.description: Empty fact lists give no STATE section.

expect.text:
RESPONSE
<<<
r
>>>

TARGET
<<<
t
>>>

TYPE
<<<
number
>>>

MODE
<<<
lenient
>>>
